Tripura High Court Junior Administrative Assistant Result 2026 Out - Check Eligible List, Call Letter Date at thc.nic.in - Complete Details

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 16 September 2026
  • Written Screening Test Date : 11 October 2026 (Sunday)
  • Exam City : Agartala
  • Candidates Declared Eligible : 4,712
  • Candidates Declared Ineligible : 133

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Junior Administrative Assistant (JAA)
  • Written Screening Test Date : 11 October 2026 (Sunday)
  • Call Letter Download Starts : 1 October 2026
  • Eligible/Ineligible List & Screening Test Notification issued : 16 September 2026
  • Call Letter download starts : 01 October 2026 onwards

  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
